title: CustomerObjectiveDetail
description: Per-call schema for the customer-perspective Round 2 elaboration. Customer objectives use `panel` (consumer/channel/partner), NOT `category`. The `id` and `title` are not requested — assigned by assembly + provided as call input respectively. `linked_opportunity_indices` was added in Phase 1b of `redesign-analysis-visuals` so the AI annotates each objective with the opportunities that would advance it.

linked_opportunity_indices.description: 0-based indices into the `opportunities` array shown in the prompt. List opportunities whose execution would directly advance THIS objective. Empty list when no opportunity in the list applies.
